verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Grafana sandbox or test environment that is isolated from production data. The closest items are adjacent: the as-code CLI can 'manage multiple environments' for CI/CD and local development, Loki can be run locally in monolithic mode, and Enterprise Logs offers per-tenant logical isolation. None of these is a product-provided sandbox, and using them this way amounts to a user-side arrangement, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
